**Approval threshold** (approve when P(default) < 0.180). Costs: an approved defaulter loses 45% of the loan amount; a rejected good customer costs 10% of the loan amount in lost margin (illustrative assumptions; break-even probability for a calibrated model = 0.182). Chosen on out-of-fold predictions, reported on the hold-out:

| Segment | Approval rate | Default rate, approved | Default rate, declined | Defaults caught | Good customers declined | Cost saving vs approve-all |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| All applicants | 88.8% | 5.36% | 29.6% | 41.0% | 8.6% | 17.3% |
| No bureau record | 84.2% | 6.03% | 31.3% | 49.3% | 12.1% | 21.9% |
| Thin-file | 94.1% | 5.38% | 37.9% | 30.6% | 3.9% | 17.1% |

Segment-specific thresholds (chosen on out-of-fold data, not deployed): Thin-file 0.170 -> hold-out approval 92.9%, default rate among approved 5.23%; No bureau record 0.165 -> hold-out approval 82.1%, default rate among approved 5.89%.
